title: General-public usability review
summary: Added the single consolidated, evidence-limited general-public usability review for all fifteen primary tabs.
reason: Document usability and accessibility barriers for non-technical public users without changing application behavior or safety ownership.
behavior_before: No current consolidated general-public usability review covered all primary tabs.
behavior_after: One actionable review report records tab findings, cross-tab themes, prioritized backlog, quick wins, and post-fix validation.
manual_validation: Read the goal objective and used one assigned review worker per primary tab, in sequential batches.
Verified the report includes all fifteen primary tabs, top recommendations, cross-tab findings, backlog, quick wins, and validation checklist.
Recorded the authenticated-browser limitation and did not perform destructive or media-mutating actions.
rollback_plan: Remove the report and this change packet if the review record must be withdrawn; no application behavior or runtime state changed.
notes:
Single consolidated evidence-based general-public usability review.
Tracks the review documentation change.
